## Intent and source

Link the accepted requirement and describe the learner or maintainer outcome.

## Change surface

List affected routes, contracts, lesson/exercise IDs and versions. Describe draft, evidence and migration behavior where relevant.

## Review evidence

For learning changes, explain the scaffold gradient, fresh transfer, fixture outcomes and hint disclosure. For UI changes, share synthetic states with theme, viewport and reproduction steps.

| Check | Result and environment |
| --- | --- |
| Typecheck, tests and build | |

## Independent review

List uncovered paths, known limits and any consequential decisions needed. Point reviewers to the most important source, fixture or state to inspect. Approval and merge are separate.
